title: Chuseok: The Journey Home
description:
Eve of the Chuseok holiday.
Highway estimated travel time: 6 hours (normally 3).
KTX tickets sold out three months ago.

Go home, or stay?

choices.text: Go no matter what — holidays are holidays
choices.result_text:
Six hours by intercity bus. Made it.

Mother was waiting in front of the jesa table.
The relief when the long journey ends makes the bus fare irrelevant.

choices.text: Stay in Seoul this time — give them a call
choices.result_text:
'you can't make it this time.' you called.
'you know, you're busy.' Her voice.

The loneliness of spending a Korean holiday alone in Seoul — it's hard to put into words.

title: Seollal: The New Year's Bow
description:
Seollal morning — time for sebae, the New Year's bow.
You bow to the elders. A small envelope of sebae money comes back.

But the older you get, this ritual gets complicated.
'Did you find work yet?' 'When are you getting married?'

choices.text: Holiday nagging is part of the relationship — deflect with a smile
choices.result_text:
'I'm working hard.' Smiled it off.

100,000 won in sebae money went into the wallet.
The lecture and the money always come together. That's Korean holidays.

choices.text: Tell them honestly where things stand
choices.result_text:
'Still job hunting, but I'm preparing.'

The relative listened more seriously than expected.
Sometimes being honest beats hiding it.

title: Holidays Alone
description:
Holiday weekend — Seoul empties out.
Over half the convenience stores are closed.

Not a single sound from the goshiwon hallway.
Everyone went home.

choices.text: Accept it as time to yourself
choices.result_text:
Walked through a Seoul with no one in it.

The riverside was empty. Han River bridges in the distance.
Once a year, this city breathes.

choices.text: Reach out to a friend who also stayed — grab a meal
choices.result_text:
Two friends who couldn't go home gathered.
Bought convenience store lunch boxes and ate in the park.

Even a holiday without a hometown becomes a holiday when there are people.
